name: RA2 Toolbox 1.0.39-pre.7
source: Current rendering branch: x64 external host with x86 GameRuntime and hook broker; Vulkan rendering is optional.
resources: Update package reuses existing assets/profiles/preprocessing runtime/engine
validation: verify_crossbit_abi.py compares actual Windows x86/x64 wire declarations; verify_windows_outputs.py verifies exact PE architectures and current exported protocol; Windows broker and rendering CI are required for the final build
build_requirement: Zig 0.13.0; x86 paired build or x64 host with x86 runtime and broker.
package_type: Architecture-labelled experimental update; exact output PE metadata is generated by verify_windows_outputs.py, not inferred from historical tracked output manifests
game_code_patching: Material replacement leaves native shroud/fog drawing code unchanged; older experimental modes remain available and may install existing managed patches.
input_entry: Manager WH_GETMESSAGE / WH_CALLWNDPROCRET only; features have no independent hooks
symbolic_original_interfaces: EventClass original constructors + SP DoList / MP OutList
DisplayClass::ScrollMap (0x4A9840), rate-scaled adapter for experimental scrolling
release_status: 1.0.39-pre.7; prerelease publication requires the final same-commit build and frontend checks
frontend: Independent settings input queues; latest-layout snapshots; dependency gating; explicit key gestures; page-only wheel scrolling
technology_experiment: Native AddCameo + two local UI CanBuild limit-only callsite wrappers; native factories/events unchanged; no live purchase/netplay certification
calculation_locations: Fifteen tactical decision families selectable; native queries/events always GameRuntime; host planner and six value-only compute lanes run on persistent workers, with UI publication and original source deadlines.
player_control: Experimental shared control retained; current-player switching and enemy-building Sell disabled
refresh_experiment: Cursor high refresh enabled; scene/forced refresh and view zoom entries disabled
render_effect_coverage: See ANIMATION_RENDER_COVERAGE.md: HVA frames, standard VoxelAnim, fire/pixel particles, independent laser/radiation/wave/alpha/glow paths now integrated; new procedural effects use a CPU post-pass over shared CPU/GPU scene output, with native A/Z and exact pixels still uncertified.

Hotfix13.ui: Video/Control/Automatic/GameRules/Experimental; original three masters removed; video owns cursor/render and monitoring/watch/minimap
Hotfix13.defaults: particles, lasers, VXL and SHP relighting ON; individual persisted OFF choices retained; extra quality/xBRZ/Vulkan remain opt-in
Hotfix13.shared_world: same immutable SceneBank, same SceneRenderer and presentation profile for main, watch and real minimap; feature-specific tactical facts and late game-thread validation remain
Hotfix13.shared_native_materials: bounded immutable native pre-scale VXL/SHP result bank + native TMP cache; viewport composition/scaling remains per camera, not one full-world screenshot
Hotfix13.local_ui: main-only command/selection/cursor and native message/SW+mission timer preservation; conservative primary-factory/rally passthrough; no Phobos chat replacement or pixel-perfect claim
Hotfix13.particles: certified BehavesLike 0/1 SHP frames/opacity; directional fire, pixel particles, waves, RadBeam, VoxelAnim and several special effects remain incomplete

Hotfix14.local_ui: Replaces broad native message/timer/primary/rally passthrough rectangles with independent main-view font masks and patterned lines; current GAME.FNT and CSF values read-only; four cached compositor textures on a private reader/worker
Hotfix14.reference: Vera20k 0b6a073d0928453036c4a53d117bb7a2d8d573a7 font, anchors and rally pixel walk; cnc-ddraw 279a057ee7e1e4d584b56141c014ab01f3c6ee6d format/palette comparison only
Hotfix14.validation_limit: Portable controlled regressions and local cross compilation; no Windows game/GPU/FPS or pixel-perfect font certification; custom UI, input caret, sloped/object rally destinations remain incomplete

Hotfix15.world: Shared immutable effect snapshots and CPU/GPU viewport output for laser/prism/disk segments, straight radiation/temporal beams, sonic/magnetic displacement, pixel particles, alpha shapes and glow; no native timers, RNG or draw methods called
Hotfix15.hva_debris: All HVA matrices retained; current body/turret counters and cache identities; independent VoxelAnim array, current bounce quaternion, floor/bridge shadow, raw VXL without HVA, shared immutable debris geometry
Hotfix15.main_ui: Main-only group/rank/repair/power status; exact-floor/object rally resolver; Campaign held/full timers omitted; queued Foot navigation nodes/labels; full PlanMgr graph and custom UI remain partial
Hotfix15.formation: Shared native material bank and ViewportCanvas CPU/GPU compositor/profile; private ghost placement, bounded elapsed-time decode rotation, cached palette invalidation; final bitmap drawn without per-pixel UI processing
Hotfix15.limits: No live Windows/game/GPU/netplay/FPS measurement. Eruption RadBeam2, legacy Wave1/2, building-light beams, complete PlanMgr graph, full-screen distortions and arbitrary mod UI still incomplete.

Hotfix16.cpu_area: Revision-scoped native-page integral cache shared across row workers and views; 256 MiB retained x64 / 32 MiB x86, invalidated by page writes, immutable COW snapshots retained. Dense shrink no longer directly samples half a page before constructing sums.
Hotfix16.cpu_dirty: Whole-map CPU output resumes from the immediately preceding unmasked object revision. Only changed and removed object pages are refiltered; background/view/backend or failed-frame mismatches use the complete base.
Hotfix16.verification: Seven focused CPU regressions and local Zig mixed-architecture build; no Vulkan execution in this continuation; no live Windows/game/FPS measurement.
